_comment: PROTECTED — the trading agent may not edit this file or anything in core/. Changes here are made by the human operator only.

screener._comment: Tunables for the screening tier (core/screen.py). Screening judgment comes from Haiku subagents the cycle agent fans out with its Task tool, so the day's cost is counted in batches, not dollars - there is no API path and no model field. The max_batches_per_day and max_pool_after_strata hard ceilings live in core/validate.py and core/screen.py; raising either is a protected-core edit by design.

venues._comment: Operator, 2026-10-14. Polymarket refuses this fork's machine (HTTP 451; South Korea blocked it on 2026-08-18), and it is never to be worked around. Myriad Markets is the phase-A venue: stake-free forecasts only, from its public read API, written to journal/forecasts-myriad.jsonl and never pooled with Polymarket history. bets_enabled stays false until a Myriad paper broker exists (phase B); that broker starts from its own sim_bankroll_usd. Sports and esports markets are excluded (National Sports Promotion Act: no supplying information for unlicensed sports betting; this journal is public). core/myriad.py enforces every field here.

real._comment: Caps for real execution via Pearl Connect (laptop only). Hard ceilings live in core/validate.py; raising them is a protected-core edit by design.
